ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: In a 24-hour period, how many times do the hour and minute hands coincide on a standard clock?

Solution: 
Our clock generally has 12 hours. Every 12 hours, the hour hand and the minute hand meet 11 times.

This is because at 11:55, the minute hand can never be exactly on the hour hand; when it catches up with it, it is already 12 o'clock.

Therefore, in 12 hours, when they meet 11 times, in 24 hours (11 × 2) they will meet 22 times.

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ৩) If January 1, 2025 is on a Wednesday, what day will January 1, 2027 fall on?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: If January 1, 2025 is on a Wednesday, what day will January 1, 2027 fall on?

Solution:
Except for a leap year, the first and last days of every year fall on the same day of the week. In a leap year, one extra day must be added.

The year 2025 is not a leap year.
If January 1st, 2025, is a Wednesday, then the last day of the year will also be a Wednesday.

January 1st, 2026, will be a Thursday.
The last day of 2026 will also be a Thursday.

January 1st, 2027, will be a Friday.

If wheel D rotates in the direction of the clock hands, wheel C will rotate opposite to the direction of the clock hands.

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১০) If the weight of the object is 30 kg, how much force is required to lift the object?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: If the weight of the object is 30 kg, how much force is required to lift the object?



Solution:
• Given:
Weight of Object (W) = 30 kg
Gravitational Acceleration (g) = 9.81 m/s²
Number of Ropes Supporting the Load = 1

Calculation of the the Weight Force (Load):
Weight Force = Mass × Gravity
Weight Force=Mass × Gravity = 30 × 9.81 =30 × 9.81 = 294.3 N = 294.3 N

Determination of the Mechanical Advantage (MA):
Since there is only one rope supporting the load, the mechanical advantage is:
MA = 1

Calculation of the Required Force:
Effort Force= MA/Load Force
= 1/294.3
= 294.3 N

The required force to lift the object is 294.3 N (approximately 294 N).

Since this is a single fixed pulley, it only changes the direction of force but does not reduce the effort needed.

ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.question: ১২) A circuit has a resistor of 80Ω and a current of 2A is flowing through it. What is the voltage across the resistor?
ব্যাংক ডেইলি কুইজ.exp:
Question: A circuit has a resistor of 80Ω and a current of 2A is flowing through it. What is the voltage across the resistor?

Solution:
To find the voltage across the resistor, I'll use Ohm's Law:
V = I × R
Where:

V is the voltage (in volts)
I is the current (in amperes)
R is the resistance (in ohms)

Given:

Resistance (R) = 80Ω
Current (I) = 2A

Substituting these values:
V = 2A × 80Ω
V = 160V
Therefore, the voltage across the 80Ω resistor is 160 volts.
